text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock E after a 16.7% gain felt satisfying, but I should base future sales on its prospects and my portfolio needs, not simply on the pleasure of locking in gains.","My account rose from NT$99,287 to NT$113,782 while I made no further trades, reinforcing that patience can pay off and that I need not react to every monthly fluctuation.","I should continue to consider diversification and risk, making deliberate decisions that suit my long-term goals rather than letting short-term moves or losses drive my choices."]}
